# Website AIEO Checker

> A free deterministic website auditing tool by SkyDevLab for AI Engine Optimization (AIEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and AI search readiness.

## Overview

Website AIEO Checker evaluates publicly accessible website signals across five dimensions:

1. AI Crawlability — robots.txt, AI crawler directives, HTTPS, canonical URLs, HTTP status, XML sitemaps, and llms.txt availability.
2. Content Structure — semantic HTML, heading hierarchy, page structure, metadata, and content completeness.
3. Structured Data — Schema.org JSON-LD parsing, recognized entity types, and machine-readable relationships.
4. Entity Clarity — consistency and clarity of organization, person, website, and related entity signals.
5. Answer Readiness — deterministic coverage of common questions and factual answer signals.

## Methodology

- Deterministic rules; no generative AI scoring dependency.
- Scores are based on observable public website signals.
- Results do not guarantee ranking, indexing, citation, visibility, or recommendation by any specific AI or search system.
